skill.name: plugin-creator
skill.description: Create and scaffold plugin directories for Codex with a required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, optional plugin folders/files, valid manifest defaults, and personal-marketplace entries by default. Use when Codex needs to create a new personal plugin, add optional plugin structure, generate or update marketplace entries for plugin ordering and availability metadata, or update an existing local plugin during development with the CLI-driven cachebuster and reinstall flow.
skill.summary: Scaffold, validate, register, and refresh local Codex plugins and personal marketplace entries.
skill.author: openai

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally creates and updates plugin files, including hidden Codex configuration under the user home directory. URL, IP, reconnaissance, path traversal, and shell backtick alerts are false positives caused by examples, SVG data, known paths, or Markdown. No prompt injection or unsafe command execution was found.

remediation.issue: The default personal marketplace workflow can modify a hidden file under the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before creating or updating the personal marketplace, and show the exact destination path.

content.value_statement: Manual plugin setup can produce invalid manifests and inconsistent marketplace entries. This skill scaffolds validated local plugins and manages personal marketplace metadata.
actual_capabilities: Normalizes plugin names and creates validation-ready plugin manifests.
Creates optional skills, hooks, scripts, assets, MCP, and app structures.
Creates or updates personal and repository marketplace entries with required policies.
Validates plugin manifests, skill metadata, companion files, URLs, assets, and semantic versions.
Refreshes local plugin versions with a single Codex cachebuster suffix.
Reads marketplace names from personal or repository marketplace files.
limitations: Creates structural scaffolds only; it does not implement plugin business logic.
Generated names, descriptions, prompts, and author metadata require project-specific editing.
Marketplace integration targets local filesystem entries and does not publish remote packages.
Validation follows the bundled contract and may not cover newer platform fields.

use_cases.title: Build a personal plugin
use_cases.description: Create a personal plugin scaffold and register it in the default Codex marketplace.

use_cases.title: Standardize team scaffolds
use_cases.description: Create repository plugins with optional skills, hooks, scripts, assets, MCP, and app files.

use_cases.title: Maintain local plugins
use_cases.description: Validate manifests and refresh cachebuster versions during local development.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic plugin
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a local plugin named [name] in my personal marketplace. Use default manifest values, then validate the result.

prompt_templates.title: Add plugin components
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [name] with skills, scripts, assets, MCP, and app companion files at [parent path]. Add it to my personal marketplace.

prompt_templates.title: Create a team plugin
prompt_templates.prompt: Scaffold [name] under [repository plugins path] and update [marketplace path]. Apply the requested installation policy, authentication policy, and category.

prompt_templates.title: Update an existing plugin
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the cachebuster for [plugin path], validate the plugin, and report contract failures. Preserve existing marketplace metadata and plugin content.

output_examples.input: Create a personal plugin named Incident Tools with skills and scripts.
output: Created the manifest, skills directory, and scripts directory.
Added the local marketplace entry and completed validation.

output_examples.input: Validate the plugin in my current repository.
output_examples.output: Validation failed because the manifest lacks a default prompt and references a missing icon. No files were changed.

output_examples.input: Refresh the cachebuster for my local plugin.
output_examples.output: Updated the plugin version with one Codex cachebuster suffix. The remaining manifest content was preserved.

best_practices: Specify whether the destination is personal or repository based before scaffolding.
Review generated metadata before treating the plugin as complete.
Run bundled validation after every manifest, skill, MCP, app, or asset change.
anti_patterns: Do not use force when existing files or marketplace entries have not been reviewed.
Do not add MCP or app manifest fields without creating their companion files.
Do not hand-edit marketplace metadata during cachebuster updates.

faq.question: Does this skill publish plugins remotely?
faq.answer: No. It creates and manages local plugin files and marketplace entries.

faq.question: Which file is always created?
faq.answer: Every scaffold includes a plugin manifest under the required hidden plugin directory.

faq.question: Can it create optional plugin components?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create skills, hooks, scripts, assets, MCP, and app structures when requested.

faq.question: Will it overwrite existing files?
faq.answer: Existing files are preserved unless force is explicitly enabled. Existing marketplace entries also require force for replacement.

faq.question: Can it create repository or team plugins?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide explicit plugin and marketplace paths for a repository or team workflow.

faq.question: Does validation execute plugin code?
faq.answer: No. The validator parses manifests and metadata, checks paths, and verifies referenced local files.
